notes.title: Youtubers Life 2 Update 1.4.0
notes.content:
Hello Youtubers,

You now have available the [b]new 1.4.0 update for Youtubers Life 2[/b], which includes the following fixes:

[list]
[*] Improvements in game optimization.
[*] New language available: Catalan.
[*] Teleport: Now you can use the game map to teleport to different places.
[*] Gigi bug fix: Fixed the bug that can appear in a Gigi's mission and that prevented to complete the game.
[*] Furniture bug fix: Misplaced furniture will no longer be automatically sent to the inventory and will remain hidden, now they will remain misplaced.
[*] Minor bug fixes.
[/list]

[h2]You can now add Youtubers Life 3 - Stream Together to your wishlist![/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3487060/Youtubers_Life_3__Stream_Together/

[b]Youtubers Life 3 - Stream Together![/b] has been announced and will be a reality this 2025. We encourage you to visit the Steam page of the game so you can save it to your wishlist and be updated at all times on the latest news of this game.

Thank you for being part of the Youtubers Life community. Feel free to share your opinion and comments on the Steam forums or on the Discord server.

notes.title: NEW HOTFIX COMING SOON!
notes.content:
Hi Youtubers,

We hope that you are enjoying your road to fame with the new features and gameplay added in the #CityStories Update! We are so glad to receive your feedback and keep improving the game in a new upcoming hotfix coming soon.

Below you can check some issues and questions we have been receiving, along with some workarounds until the new patch is live:

[h3][b]Main reported issues and temporary workarounds[/b][/h3]

[b]Game menus may get blocked after opening a new package.[/b]
We are working on fixing this issue in the upcoming hotfix. If you have ever experienced it, you can unlock the menu again by going to sleep and moving on to the next day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/1b98fad05f73fa4b9b3effa8db6be1f2e1758619.png[/img]

[b]If your backpack is full and you try to pick up a new item, the item may disappear if you leave the place[/b]
We are fixing this bug in the next patch too. Until then, try to keep some empty slots in your backpack before exploring and completing any quest. If you find a new item and your backpack is full already, you can dump or sell items to get some free space right away, and then pick up the new item again, but don't leave the scene to avoid the item disappearing!

If you are at home and you are going to go out to start a new adventure, you can also save some of your items in your storage to get some empty slots before it. Also, don't forget that you can expand your backpack with additional slots at Geektopia to be able to carry more items at once!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/22cb9ec5b96e7bff29d034c2012d3893ac1a1cc6.png[/img]

[b]General minor bugfixing[/b]
[list]
[*] We are fixing the block when opening the camera or Map while drinking water
[*] We are fixing the bug that prevents players from completing Adam's "Five videos with secrets" quest.
[*] Some typos in the dialogues will be revised.
[*] Other minor fixes will be fixed.
[/list]

[h3][b]Other frequently asked questions:[/b][/h3]

[b]New cutscenes and rewards from friendship quests do not show up in old save games.[/b]
With the #CityStores Free Update Launch, we have improved several cutscenes and dialogues when building a new relationship with NPCs, as well as new rewards after completing some of their stories, but these improvements will just appear for relationships you haven't completed yet. If there are some NPCs you want to grow a friendship with, and you haven't struck up a relationship with them yet, this is your chance to start it right away!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/f5274164a64f62f27a31f3fe4250841ba38b22ab.png[/img]

[b]Taking photos with video games in the background does not capture the trend for Instalife.[/b]
To allow you to focus on capturing specific trends rather than capturing several others unintentionally, we've slightly adjusted the trends-catching system, making it no longer possible to capture a video game trend when it is placed in the background. Just pick it up, hold it and then take a nice pic to capture the trend! This will help you capture only the trends you want for your channel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/fd27aba77a033f2d3c9a3b1115814bf24990e2f0.png[/img]


There are other minor adjustments we will cover in the next patch to improve your gaming experience according to your feedback. Thank you so much for your support and for being part of the Youtubers Life Community.

And don't forget that you can also check out our official FAQs in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1493760/discussions/0/3473990693213288709/]Steam forums[/url] to find useful information and more workarounds!

notes.title: 2 MILLION PLAYERS AND THE BIGGEST UPDATE SO FAR WITH OVER 1,000 IMPROVEMENTS!
notes.content:
Hi Youtubers!

It’s been a month since we announced the #CityStories update, a free update for Youtubers Life 2 that brings new ways of playing the game, exploring NewTube City and experiencing all its hidden adventures! Finally today, we have some big news to celebrate with you!

[h3][b]Youtubers Life franchise reaches[/b][/h3]
[h2][b]2 MILLION lifetime players![/b][/h2]
Matching the first anniversary of Youtubers Life 2, the whole franchise reaches [b]2 million players[/b] who have started their road to fame across all platforms. To celebrate it, now you can update Youtubers Life 2 with more than 1,000 improvements for FREE!

The #CityStories update comes as a celebration for your support during these 12 months Youtubers Life 2 has been released. With over [b]3,000 streamers[/b] playing the game, and more than 50 million views on Youtube achieved during its first year, we couldn’t be happier with how well you have received Youtubers Life 2. Thank you!

[h3][b]Let’s take a look at the new trailer and everything that’s coming to your game right now![/b][/h3]

[previewyoutube=8wQJ1SS3CBI;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][b]Complete challenges and get more stuff from the[/b][/h3]
[h2][b]New Tubitickets Terminal![/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/31dd8e28bcf5a876ef4540fc1709b30f958ec8e6.png[/img]

With the new Tubiticket feature, you can complete challenges and redeem points at the Tubiticket Terminal. You’ll obtain different resources, such as special discounts, upgrades to your channels, boost for your friendships and even additional items. You will never run out of stuff to do!

[h3][b]Choose the way you want to grow with the[/b][/h3]
[h2][b]New Skill Tree![/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/6d72e0f9f7e7e5db205c4f1eb30fb4911a904316.png[/img]
Produce and publish content to earn skill points, and develop your skills as a Youtuber. You will be able to unlock new scripts for your videos and improve their performance. Master your abilities, improve your workshops and create the most unique content online!

[h3][b]Become whoever you want to be with[/b][/h3]
[h2][b]New Customization Items and Rewards!![/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/f1d2dfb7f09700d45134bb762ef1deb33ea37ae7.jpg[/img]

Has your style gone out of fashion? Refresh your identity with new personalization options for your character creations, new clothes and costumes, awesome new furniture collections to decorate your home and interactive items to make your setup alive!

[h3][b]Dash around the city[/b][/h3]
[h2][b]On your Unicycle![/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/0889f98f92128a51a55fd38a7cdb655dd5ad73ff.jpg[/img]
Wandering the streets looking for a scooter station is not classy enough for an internet celebrity like you. Hop on your unicycle whenever you want, race through NewTube City and get those trends before they’re gone. Don’t forget to snap some pics on the way!

[h3][b]Grow your network and enjoy[/b][/h3]
[h2][b]Improved Friendship Stories and Cutscenes![/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/49de68ce703b90a8e1cdf5c4485e5e2ba43ecaf9.jpg[/img]
It’s time to forge relationships with more than 30 charismatic characters! Become involved in their lives and build meaningful friendships, now with fresher dialogues, new cutscenes and exclusive rewards. 

[h3][b]Create content as never before with[/b][/h3]
[h2][b]New Card Benefits and Masteries![/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/0596a3709e8d941564fbf598fd6098fbc9bb565b.jpg[/img]
You will be able to increase your video score by using the newly added card effects, by obtaining temporary buffs while you record your videos. Mix that with the new Mastery feature and showcase your expertise in the different video game genres to get the most views.

[h3][b]Over 1,000 new additional[/b][/h3]
[h2][b]Improvements and Fixes![/b][/h2]

We have been listening to you and gathering your feedback to massively improve on the game experience and fix a huge amount of annoying bugs that have been reported to us. We can’t wait to hear what you think about it! 

Expand the following list to check out some of the most important fixes thanks to your feedback, but remember that there are tons more you can discover in-game right away!
[expand type=details]
[list]
[*] We’ve fixed the bug in which workstations became invisible and blocked the entrance door when players tried to customized them.
[*] Fixed an issue where upgrades for the gaming corner were blocked and showed prices at 999.999 or “Nombre” as their name.
[*] Workstation customization now won’t reset once applied.
[*] The bug which did not allow you to upgrade your workstations has been fixed. Upgrades are not blocked anymore after upgrading your house.
[*] Character blocks when opening the photo album app, speaking to NPCs or going to sleep have been fixed.
[*] Fixed an issue where new published videos showed as repetitions of previous ones, as well as several bugs with the video editing workstation.
[*] Fixed an issue in which the resolution of the game was defaulted to an incorrect aspect ratio.
[*] Several crashes which resulted in deleted saves under specific conditions have been fixed.
[*] Issues with the PC components' durability have been fixed.
[*] Issues with the spawn of NPCs have been fixed.
[*] Fixed an issue where going to sleep resulted in an infinite loop, forcing the player to restart the game.
[*] Fixed an issue in which stores didn’t show the correct items available.
[*] Baba May won’t clip with tables when sitting next to them. She won’t get up from her wheelchair when you speak to her either.
[*] The scroll in the game menu on your workstation is not missing anymore.
[*] You can now order on Amazing On when your inventory is full.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Instalife app camera was placed in the position of the gameplay camera.
[*] Fixed an issue where performing two different actions at the same time resulted in a softlock.
[*] Going out during a storm in the Port neighborhood won’t trigger a loud thunder sound.
[*] Conditions to trigger the #FitDayChallenge trend have been changed, making it much easier to obtain.
[*] Fixed an issue where the drone’s message was incorrectly shown in the house upgrade menu.
[*] Fixed an issue where it was possible to clip with subway entrances while on scooter.
[*] Fixed an issue where the camera position when getting to the Uptown district by subway was incorrect.
[*] Fixed an issue where NPCs could move the player’s position while the prompt to exercise was on screen, making it impossible to interact with the exercise machines.
[*] Fixed an issue where options to upgrade your furniture were shown, but couldn’t be obtained.
[*] Fixed an issue where the characters’ appearance on the ‘Contacts’ app wasn’t updated.
[*] Fixed an issue where the music from an area didn’t reproduce after a friendship event in said area.
[*] Sliders on the settings menu now play a sound when selecting a new value.
[*] Fixed an issue where you were softlocked inside buildings.
[*] Fixed an issue where you weren’t able to talk to DJ Cerulean during her friendship event.
[*] Reactions during video recordings are not working.
[*] Fixed an issue where the golden skin drone bug wasn’t available at the Drone app after having obtained it.
[*] Fixed an issue where Katzia NT quest couldn't be completed after you had done unboxings of all the items from one of the stores she requested.
[*] Fixed an issue in which Zane's friendship blocked the game.
[*] Fixed an issue where you could run out of energy during Inoxtag quest, resulting in a softlock.
[*] Fixed an issue where Paluten and GermanLetsPlay’s quest crashed and couldn’t be completed.
[*] Fixed an issue where Dorian's affinity didn’t rise.
[*] Adam's USB for his first friendship quest can be obtained again after you divorce him and erase his memory.
[*] The player won’t be locked in Elite Fitness Club after closing time.
[*] Some texture glitches have been fixed.
[*] Several issues with texts, localization, and dialogues have been fixed.
[*] Several issues with the interface have been fixed.
[*] Several issues with characters’ affinities and gifts have been fixed.
[*] Several issues during cutscenes have been fixed (incorrect positions, missing dialogues, etc).
[*] Several issues with character animations have been fixed.
[*] Many other fixes to improve the gaming experience.
[/list]
[/expand]

On top of that, here is one more surprise for you:
[h3][b]The brand new official Youtubers Life 2 Characters Guide is now available! [/b][/h3]
This additional FREE content includes almost 80 pages of exclusive designs and information about the stories, likes, quests, hobbies, agendas, and much more stuff from over 30 characters in the game. You can download it for FREE through [url=https://bit.ly/3MzSGYV]this link [/url]or by scanning the QR Code below: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/afc3a875fc53f1c8e7d1ec9ad60447fd2cd0b196.png[/img]


Remember that you can get the game at a discounted price until October 27th!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1493760/Youtubers_Life_2/


[h3][b]Youtubers Life 2: #CityStories is out! Your road to fame starts now![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/aa294a28ad3564e5e98d5e531829a6f5c76c9c44.jpg[/img]

notes.title: OVER 1,000 IMPROVEMENTS TO CELEBRATE THE 1-YEAR ANNIVERSARY ON OCTOBER 20TH!
notes.content:
Hi Youtubers!

We know that you've been expecting news from us about the next updates. Well, now we can finally share with you juicy details about it Thank you so much for your patience and we hope you like it!

Celebrating the 1-Year Anniversary of Youtubers Life 2, the new #CityStories update will bring new ways to start your road to fame, thus enhancing your adventure, friendships, and exploration features!

[h3][b]Check this out to see what's coming on[/b] [/h3]
[h2][b]October 20th![/b][/h2]
[previewyoutube=soSz-MtBDEU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Level up your fandom with the [/b][/h3]
[h2][b]New Skills Tree![/b][/h2]
Choose the way you want to grow your expertise by unlocking scripts and workshops through the new Skills Tree. Post what you live and what you discover out there to earn tons of cash and skill points you can use to learn new abilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/7e576e3ff4687413a4e1d152041cfe1e91cc9894.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Become whoever you want to be with[/b][/h3]
[h2][b]New Customization Items and Rewards!![/b][/h2]
New options for character creation, clothes and costumes to personalize your character as you want, furniture to decorate your home with astonishing styles, and even new items you can interact with. Grab them from quests or secret places, and become unique!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/25ccc05e9a2f60dff16c4c36094cb7b427605079.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Complete challenges and get more stuff from the[/b][/h3]
[h2][b]New Tubitickets Terminal![/b][/h2]
Special discounts at different stores, benefits for training, upgrades for your channel, boosts for your friendships, additional items for your character or home... You will be able to grab new improvements for your daily life by completing challenges and getting points you can redeem in the new Tubitickets Terminal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/73e4c8f93731f426f922df37aa6c84871484e06e.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Discover what's trending out there [/b][/h3]
[h2][b]On your Unicycle![/b][/h2]
The best way to travel around NewTube City is almost here! Take it from your pocket and get on it whenever you want out there to take great pics on the way, capture trends for your channel, or just go visit a friend in town!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/4b1cd65e4cbc4b80598f5d389ad6efcac2f83394.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Grow your network and enjoy[/b][/h3]
[h2][b]Improved Friendship Stories and Cutscenes![/b][/h2]
In this redesigned adventure where every trend is a story to be discovered, Youtubers, Gaming, Time traveling, Mutants, and many more secrets will stand before those who accept the challenge. The new update will bring new cutscenes, fresher dialogues, and better rewards you will get from helping other characters with their personal issues. Discover the secrets of [b]over 30 characters[/b] and collect their unique items to prove your great deeds and relive your adventures!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/8e5a6b70ffc5fafccf39016ff2faffcd12799981.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Create content as never before with[/b][/h3]
[h2][b]New Card Benefits and Masteries![/b][/h2]
Increase your scoring and get more followers and coins by selecting cards with new benefits when recording a video! Use them strategically and impress your fans with your best creations. But that's not all, 'cause the new update will also bring a new Mastery feature that will allow you to specialize in different video game genres as you prefer, such as Adventure, RPG, Survival, Action, and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/535d3784ae9977616e0b88ca16ef36551476c4c3.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Over 1,000 new additional[/b][/h3]
[h2][b]Improvements and Fixes![/b][/h2]
Thanks to all your reports and notifications, we have detected and fixed many elements of the game and improved numerous features that will enhance your gaming experience. Thank you all for your precious feedback!


Stay tuned to know more about what's coming to Youtubers Life 2 and join us on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/aDEmU2j7KC]official discord server[/url] to have fun with the community! 
[h3][/h3]

The best way to travel around NewTube City is almost here! Take it from your pocket and get on it whenever you want out there to take great pics on the way, capture trends for your channel, or just go visit a friend in town!
The new update will bring new cutscenes, fresher dialogues, and better rewards you will get from helping other characters with their personal issues.
Increase your scoring and get more followers and coins by selecting cards with new benefits when recording a video!

But that's not all, 'cause the new update will also bring a new Mastery feature that will allow you to specialize in different video game genres as you prefer, such as Adventure, RPG, Survival, Action, and more!

notes.title: YOUTUBERS LIFE 2 OFFICIAL FAQs!
notes.content:
Hello, Youtubers!

If you are looking for some answers about Youtubers Life 2, this might be your post! We have gathered some of the most Frequently Asked Questions of the game for you. We hope that this helps you in your career as a Youtuber.

[u][h3][b]FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS:[/b][/h3][/u]
[b]I divorced an NPC and now they hate me. What can I do?[/b]
You have to use the Er-Brainlyzer, which you can buy at Er-Tech Innovation Center, in order to reset the relationship. That way you can befriend them again.


[b]Why can’t I give away certain objects?[/b]
Some objects can’t be gifted or given away because they are required to complete a quest or they are key to the development of your Youtuber career. That’s why, in order to avoid you giving them away accidentally, we have taken away the ability of doing so altogether.

 
[b]Gigi is gone! How do I make her come back?[/b]
Before Gigi disappears, she will tell you to take care of her AFK plant. Then, you’ll get the plant and a watering can. In order to complete the quest, you’ll need to place this plant on a piece of furniture, and then you’ll see it’s special and you can interact with it. If you get close to the plant with the watering can, you’ll see the plant has a heart of friendship. Keep watering the plant until the heart is full and something will surely happen! When Gigi disappears, you have to water the plant every day until you reach 1 full heart of relationship in order for her to come back. The plant can be watered by placing it on a piece of furniture.

 
[b]Why can’t I go past 500 000 viewers on livestreams?[/b]
You’re not doing anything wrong! That’s the current limit of viewers you can have on a stream, so you can just focus on keeping up the good work to gain more subscribers and coins with your streamings.

 
[b]Why can’t I get more than 10 000 000 subscribers? [/b]
Don’t worry, that’s the current limit of subscribers that you can have in your channel, so if you reach this number, it means that you have become the most famous Youtuber! After that, you can keep enjoying your stardom at NewTube City by capturing new trends, making more friends, grabbing secret rewards, or progressing in other game quests.

 
[b]I can’t increase my level of friendship with Agora and Grace![/b]
Agora and Grace don’t progress in friendship and they don’t have any friendship events.

 
[b]My room has suddenly gone dark![/b]
It might be that you have accidentally turned off the lights of your house. They can be turned on again by pressing the F key or the left joystick of the controller. But who knows, maybe you prefer to keep a dimmer light for your next video...

 
[b]Why can’t I finish a quest that requires a storm if I go there when it’s raining?[/b]
Because rainy days and stormy days are not the same. Stormy days only occur in summer, so you have to wait for that season to be able to complete the quest! In order to make sure that the weather is right, you can check the weather status. On rainy days, there’s a cloud with raindrops. When there’s a storm, there’s lightning too in the weather status icon. Always look out for that!

 
[b]Tattoos, piercings, and different hairstyles aren’t showing up when I try to change my character’s style. How can I get them?[/b]
You need to purchase tattoos, piercings, and new hairstyles at the hairdresser’s counter before going to the chair. Once you do that, they should appear.

 
[b]I did a livestream with the USB Adam gave me but the USB doesn’t disappear after doing it, and the trend it contains is now white. What should I do?[/b]
You have to talk to Adam after completing the livestream in order for the USB to disappear.

 
[b]What should I do if the game tells me “Not enough render points”?[/b]
If that happens, that means you need to upgrade your computer. The option to upgrade it is unlocked after the first time your computer crashes, then the drone tells you to replace the broken components with new ones at Leet Point. Then you can interact with your computer to upgrade it by adding new components. Each component you can get at Leet Point will add a certain number of render points to your computer, so the better the component is, the higher number of render points you will be able to spend while editing your videos.


[b]After having obtained the NewTube trophy of the season, can we equip the drone? [/b]
Of course! You should be able to equip your brand new golden drone using the Drone App that you'll find in the phone menu.


[b]Can I decorate the new room that gets added when I marry an NPC?[/b]
The new room cannot be edited because it’s the other character’s room. If you get divorced and they move out, the room will disappear.


[b]Can I make time go slower?[/b]
Time can’t be slowed down in the game. But if you need to take a break, you can always open your phone and think about your next move, since that will freeze time inside the game.


[b]The texts and options in the main menu have gone crazy and they don’t display the correct titles! What is going on?[/b]
Something like this is probably happening because the game doesn't have permission to read the language files. You can either try reinstalling the game in a different unit/drive (that can be chosen in the installation settings of Steam) or you can change the security permissions of the drive in which you have currently installed the game.


[b]Why can’t I do an unboxing of any of the items I have?[/b]
Unboxings can only be made with games that you have not played yet and objects that display a box symbol next to them. So, for example, if you’ve already played a game, you won’t be able to do an unboxing of it.


[b]Why is it so hard to get stars when recording a video?[/b]
Getting good ratings for your videos can be challenging at first, so we recommend you focus on a specific star and then pick cards that will make that particular star go up. That should help improve the rating of your videos!


[b]Where can I get the costume for Inoxtag’s quest?[/b]
You can get the guard costume from Edgar, the Geektopia comic store owner, located at the south-east corner of the downtown neighborhood, at the fountain square. Once you get the costume from Edgar, remember to wear it before talking to the guards again to gain access to the laboratory.

[b]I’m stuck on a quest and I can’t seem to find a solution, what should I do?[/b]
We have a wonderful community ready to help you. Don’t be shy and post your doubts in the Steam Discussions or head to our Discord server, where other fellow Youtubers and our team will be glad to help you complete that quest that’s giving you trouble.


[u][h3][b]KNOWN ISSUES:[/b][/h3][/u]
[b]When I finish the last mission and go through the machine, the game gets stuck and Dr. Ermingaut won’t talk. I’m just stuck on the beach.[/b]
We have detected this issue and it is currently being worked on for future updates. It is a very rare issue, and if you find yourself in this situation, you can try restarting the game and trying again.


[b]I accidentally pressed kiss while my spouse was asleep, and now time is advancing even past bedtime and I can’t move.[/b]
If you wait until 8AM, your spouse will get out of bed and then your character will pass out. However, you won’t wake up until the following day. We have detected this issue and it is currently being patched. It should be fixed in the next update.


[b]I gave Gigi’s AFK plant away, what can I do to get it back?[/b]
Gigi’s AFK plant can’t be given away anymore, but if you gave it to someone before the game was updated, you can contact us and send us your save files so we can take a look and fix it for you.


[b]When I upgraded my house, my computer was sent to my storage, and when I put it back the upgrades were gone. What can I do about this?[/b]
We have already detected this issue and it is currently being patched in the next update. Meanwhile, to avoid this bug you can move your computer to the center of your current room before upgrading your house in the City Hall or if an NPC moves to your home. Once the new room is created, you can then place your computer back close to the wall. 


[b]Other common issues we have detected and are currently being worked on for future updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] We have detected that sometimes when you interact with a character, the game freezes and you should wait for your character to pass out at 4:00AM before being able to do anything.
[*] We have noticed that the game may suddenly appear to be cropped and it may show only a part of the screen.
[/list]


We hope that these solutions help you become the best Youtuber in the world! We encourage you to visit our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1493760/discussions/?snr=1_2108_9__2107]Steam discussions[/url] or participate in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/aDEmU2j7KC]Discord server[/url] to know even more.

notes.title: HOTFIX 1.2.3 IS NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
Hotfix 1.2.3 for Youtubers Life 2 is live!

In this update, we focused on further improving the overall stability of the game and fixing the most common issues. 

We hope that this hotfix improves your gaming experience while we keep working on more future upgrades. You can find the list of changes below:

[h2][b]General game adjustments and improvements[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Eyes customization options have been improved, offering more eye shapes options and the possibility to select the eye color for the shape you prefer.
[*] Added two new quests to reach the 50th and 25th positions in the ranking, thus helping you to focus on growing your channel to reach the top.
[*] Various new animations that you will find along the city have been added, thus brightening up your adventure even more!
[*] Random lightning on stormy days has been added to improve the climate feeling when exploring the city and recording videos.
[*]  The unboxing animation of your drone when you first meet it has been improved, cause you know that first impressions are always the most important!
[*] The Bronze League quest is now split into two quests to improve the game progression as a Youtuber.
[*] NPCs expressions have been revised in your contact list. Don't forget to check out the contacts app to know more about NPC's lifestyles and locations.
[*] The initial cutscene when you arrive at NewTube City has been improved, so you can enjoy the city sights from the very beginning.
[*] The first cutscene that you see when starting a New Game has been improved, thus giving you a hearty welcome to Youtubers Life 2!
[*] Chests shapes have been adjusted to improve the home decoration experience.
[*] Some colors of your home furniture have been revised to let you enjoy your Youtuber's place to the fullest.
[*] The initial home furniture when you first arrive at your place has been revised.
[*] New friendship quest icons have been added.
[*] The new clothes you get are now highlighted in your dressing room, so you don't miss your recent acquisitions anymore!
[*] Clothes are no longer duplicated in your dressing room.
[*] Feedback from the features that improve your energy has been revised.
[*] Time format has been adjusted according to your language settings and your preferences.
[*] Added widescreen compatibility for any aspect ratio.
[*] The video editing feature has been adjusted.
[*] Other general adjustments and improvements have been added to boost your gaming experience.
[/list]
[h2][b]General Bug Fixing[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the game may crash after opening the menu to eat the hamburger during the onboarding.
[*] Fixed a crash that occurred when using a record point in any of the three neighborhoods.
[*] Fixed a bug where the character could wake up on the other side of the wall if the bed was placed on the second floor.
[*] Fixed an issue about the PC fixing quest.
[*] Game's default settings have been adjusted for computers with less than 8GB RAM.
[*] Fixed a bug that displayed wrong textures when wearing a dress.
[*] Fixed a bug where players could move the camera with the directional pad when recording a video.
[*] Fixed a bug that wrongly moved the mouse cursor after selecting the first item of the video game list.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented tooltips disappear from the conversation after a heart scene in Paluten's quest.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented players from accessing Er-Tech after the InoxTag's quest.
[*] Fixed a bug from the first Lafayette's quest that revealed the recording point even before changing our look.
[*] Fixed a bug that did not show the captured trends in the scripts selection screen before recording a video.
[*] Fixed a bug that did not enable edition options in the hairdresser's secret room.
[*] Fixed a bug where players could talk to a remote NPC after receiving an item when using a controller.
[*] Fixed a bug with the controller that did not display the LT button to zoom out.
[*] Fixed a bug where a group of NPC may disappear after taking a photo with them in the Port.
[*] Fixed a bug that could crash the game when talking with an NPC 
[*] Fixed a bug that did not display the drones correctly at Er-Tech.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented players from getting the main story quest after the Mayoress's cutscene in the City Hall.
[*] Fixed a bug that did not properly display the NPC seated on benches or similar.
[*] Fixed various bugs related to the NPC's LookAt.
[*] Fixed a bug where players could offer their home keys to other NPCs even if they were already married.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented players from accessing the sewers after divorcing Katzia.
[*] Fixed a bug where the "great" result animation was blocked.
[*] Fixed an issue with the chests animations.
[*] Fixed a bug where the game kept receiving input from the controller even if the game was in the background.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented players from opening the menu with the Esc key if they had already opened any other menu from their computer.
[*] Fixed a bug that could make players pose with the controller when selecting any console or game before recording a video.
[*] Fixed a bug that could send players to the main menu after pressing "Continue" in the Day 1 summary screen.
[*] Fixed a bug that automatically raised the game music after skipping the game.
[/list]

We hope that these fixes and improvements allow you to enjoy Youtubers Life 2 to its fullest. We will keep reading your feedback and working on upcoming patches to ensure that you experience the best of your adventures as an emerging Youtuber. We also encourage you to visit our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1493760/discussions/?snr=1_2108_9__2107]Steam discussions[/url] or participate in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/aDEmU2j7KC]Discord server[/url], so we can take a closer look at your feedback and keep improving the game.

notes.title: NEW PATCH 1.2.2 IS NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
Dear youtubers,

As we promised, [b]the new Patch 1.2.2 based on your feedback is now live![/b]

This update addresses some of the most frequently reported issues since the game was released and introduces further improvements to stability and gaming experience. Here is the full list of fixes and changes:

[h2][b]Updated minigames[/b][/h2]
[b][i]Recording minigame:[/i][/b]
[list]
[*] Balanced the progress of the minigame: now you can get better scores as your level increases and it will be easier to shuffle good cards to record better videos. Also, the reaction of the character after completing the recording has been adjusted to show that the video is successfully finished.
[*] Now the emojis can be completely filled if you are close enough to fill them after finishing the recording, allowing you to get better scores.
[*] "REGULAR" type clips have been removed when recording a video.
[/list]
[b][i]Editing minigame:[/i][/b]
[list]
[*] If there are enough render points and coins left, a message now appears saying that effects can be added to clips before publishing.
[/list]
[b][i]Publishing videos:[/i][/b]
[list]
[*] Your character will better show the excitement of publishing videos according to your level as a youtuber.
[/list]
[h2][b]Onboarding[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added new indications about how to use trends when publishing a new video.
[*] Adjusted the trend capture tutorial to make it more understandable.
[*] Initial coins have been increased, allowing you to take advantage of your first savings to get new stuff from the very beginning and start your new life right away.
[*] An additional quest has been added to emphasize the progression as an emerging youtuber. Start reaching the top 75th position and keep growing to be the greatest youtuber of all times.
[/list]
[h2][b]Trends and secrets[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Now trends related to a specific location are displayed on the map.
[*] Now you can check trends information about their type and location each day through your mobile.
[*] Added related trends to InstaLife posts, thus giving some clues about their location.
[*] Now secret characters will only appear on the streets, thus making it easier to find them.
[*] Pendrives are now better dispersed throughout the city and they appear since the beginning of the game, which makes these main quest items easier to find by chance. 
[/list]
[h2][b]Commissions and Quests[/b][/h2]
[b][i]Commissions:[/i][/b]
[list]
[*] Taking photos as a commission feature has been introduced earlier in the game.
[*] Commissions rewards have been balanced to make them less necessary for progression, allowing you to focus on other quests of your choice to grow as a youtuber.
[*] Included additional indications when you pick the first package up for delivery.
[*] Added additional information about the type and location of trends required to complete a commission.
[/list]
[b][i]Quests:[/i][/b]
[list]
[*] Now you can record any video to complete the quest #PlayCon.
[*] Now you can pin up to three quests to your HUD, allowing you to follow up more missions at once.
[*] Pin icon has been replaced with a more proper one.
[*] Quests pinned on your HUD now include days.
[*] Getting the ticket to PlayCon is now a side mission.
[*] PlayCon ticket price has been adjusted.
[*] PlayCon quest now indicates the time left until the event, allowing you to check how many days you have to complete the mission.
[*] Adjusted texts now remind the day that PlayCon starts.
[*] Once you get enough coins to purchase the ticket for PlayCon, the drone tells you where you can buy it.
[*] Characters related to the FreeTicketChallenge are now in transit areas, making them easier to find.
[*] Now just two photos are needed to complete the FreeTicketChallenge quest.
[*] Now it is also indicated how many photos are left to complete the FreeTicketChallenge quest.
[/list]
[h2][b]Events, Apps, and General Features[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Night time has been adjusted, thus reducing the hours when the drone's night vision is necessary to record videos. This will give you the chance to record outside later even if you haven't got this upgrade yet.
[*] Night Vision upgrade price has been reduced.
[*] A new scooter stop has been added near the Port house.
[*] The map app has been improved.
[*] Added new instructions at the beginning of the scooter exam.
[*] Added new instructions when you fail the scooter exam.
[*] Introduction to the scooter exam has been updated to make it more understandable.
[*] Now you can buy up to 4 games per day in Retro World.
[*] The seller has been placed outside the Retro World Store to give you additional instructions about it.
[*] Added a new message that indicates whether an item has been sent to the storage.
[*] Improved the reaction cards album: now it shows the name of the character who will give you a new reaction card when completing their mission, and all trends' names are now included in the album.
[*] You can access the PlayCon VIP zone now from the Gold League.
[/list]
[h2][b]NPCs[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a new message from the drone after taking your first photo with an NPC to indicate how the relationships work.
[*] Added real-time location information of the NPCs you already know in your Contacts app. Also, don't forget to check out the Character schedule section from our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1493760/view/3050618730209297336]Youtubers Life 2 guide[/url] to know more about their daily life.
[/list]
[h2][b]HUD and Updated Guides[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a new icon on some NPCs to show if there's any action available with them. This will happen when you meet a known NPC who has a new quest available, or if you haven't spoken to them that day yet, or if there are available dialogues during an event, or if they expect to receive a package through an accepted commission. 
[*] Energy increase/decrease are numerically displayed on the energy bar.
[*] Fixed an issue with the speed of our Drone's messages.
[*] Now the Drone's messages are properly queued when there is more than one at the same time.
[*] The Drone now reminds you that you can record a video using trends you have captured if you have enough energy before ending the day.
[*] Added a new animation while recording a video.
[*] Added a shortcut to the map.
[*] More NPCs will look at you as you grow as youtuber and get into new leages, and a new popup is also added to show the excitement of your subscribers.
[/list]
[h2][b]Bug Fixing and minor improvements[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the Pendrives lost during a quest after using them, and the drone message won't display.
[*] Fixed the AM/PM format times, that now don't show double ""00s"".
[*] Fixed problems with corrupted save games.
[*] All trends are now displayed in those places where there are several trends.
[*] Circles on the grounds for photos have been removed so as not to be confused with the recording points.
[*] Fixed a bug in the InoxTag's quest.
[*] Fixed a bug in the Crainer's quest.
[*] Fixed a blocking bug during Suzy's heart scene.
[*] Fixed a bug when publishing a video through the editing workshop.
[*] Trends assigned to conferences are now displayed at the exit.
[*] Fixed a bug that slowed down the time since the second year.
[*] Fixed a visual bug that shows trends on InstaLife out of the post.
[*] HUD buttons now work properly when riding a scooter.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented recording ""Analysis"" videos in the PlayCon.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented energy consumption.
[*] NPCs on the streets are no longer shown on the subway in the Map App.
[*] Fixed a crash with the Arabic configuration.
[*] Fixed the widescreen display.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused some trends to lose progress.
[*] Fixed the bouncing when scrolling on InstaLife's feed.
[*] Removed the dates of furniture, clothing, and food in stores.
[*] Fixed a crash when changing scenes quickly.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented inputs in certain situations, just like in the streaming minigame.
[*] Fixed several camera bugs.
[*] Improved the keyboard control when moving a character.
[*] Adjusted the default resolution to 1920x1080.
[/list]
We hope that these fixes and improvements allow you to enjoy Youtubers Life 2 to its fullest. We will keep reading your feedback and working on upcoming patches to ensure that you experience the best of your adventures as an emerging youtuber. We also encourage you to visit our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1493760/discussions/?snr=1_2108_9__2107]Steam discussions[/url] or participate in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/aDEmU2j7KC]Discord server[/url], so we can take a closer look at your feedback and keep improving the game.

Happy gaming!

Added related trends to InstaLife posts, thus giving some clues about their location.

tags.balance_change: Now secret characters will only appear on the streets, thus making it easier to find them.
Pendrives are now better dispersed throughout the city and they appear since the beginning of the game, which makes these main quest items easier to find by chance.

tags.feature: Taking photos as a commission feature has been introduced earlier in the game.

tags.balance_change: Commissions rewards have been balanced to make them less necessary for progression, allowing you to focus on other quests of your choice to grow as a youtuber.

tags.feature: Included additional indications when you pick the first package up for delivery.
Added additional information about the type and location of trends required to complete a commission.
Now you can record any video to complete the quest #PlayCon.
Now you can pin up to three quests to your HUD, allowing you to follow up more missions at once.
Quests pinned on your HUD now include days.

tags.balance_change: Getting the ticket to PlayCon is now a side mission.
PlayCon ticket price has been adjusted.

tags.feature: PlayCon quest now indicates the time left until the event, allowing you to check how many days you have to complete the mission.

tags.balance_change: Characters related to the FreeTicketChallenge are now in transit areas, making them easier to find.
Now just two photos are needed to complete the FreeTicketChallenge quest.

tags.feature: Now it is also indicated how many photos are left to complete the FreeTicketChallenge quest.

tags.balance_change: Night time has been adjusted, thus reducing the hours when the drone's night vision is necessary to record videos.
Night Vision upgrade price has been reduced.

tags.feature: A new scooter stop has been added near the Port house.
Added new instructions at the beginning of the scooter exam.
Added new instructions when you fail the scooter exam.
Now you can buy up to 4 games per day in Retro World.
Added a new message that indicates whether an item has been sent to the storage.
You can access the PlayCon VIP zone now from the Gold League.
Added a new message from the drone after taking your first photo with an NPC to indicate how the relationships work.
Added real-time location information of the NPCs you already know in your Contacts app.
Added a new icon on some NPCs to show if there's any action available with them.
Energy increase/decrease are numerically displayed on the energy bar.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue with the speed of our Drone's messages.

tags.feature: Now the Drone's messages are properly queued when there is more than one at the same time.
The Drone now reminds you that you can record a video using trends you have captured if you have enough energy before ending the day.
Added a new animation while recording a video.
Added a shortcut to the map.

tags.bug: Fixed the Pendrives lost during a quest after using them, and the drone message won't display.
Fixed the AM/PM format times, that now don't show double ""00s"".
Fixed problems with corrupted save games.
Fixed a bug in the InoxTag's quest.
Fixed a bug in the Crainer's quest.
Fixed a blocking bug during Suzy's heart scene.
Fixed a bug when publishing a video through the editing workshop.
Fixed a bug that slowed down the time since the second year.
Fixed a visual bug that shows trends on InstaLife out of the post.
HUD buttons now work properly when riding a scooter.
Fixed a bug that prevented recording ""Analysis"" videos in the PlayCon.
Fixed a bug that prevented energy consumption.
NPCs on the streets are no longer shown on the subway in the Map App.
Fixed a crash with the Arabic configuration.
Fixed the widescreen display.
Fixed an issue that caused some trends to lose progress.
Fixed the bouncing when scrolling on InstaLife's feed.
Fixed a crash when changing scenes quickly.
Fixed a bug that prevented inputs in certain situations, just like in the streaming minigame.
Fixed several camera bugs.

tags.balance_change: Adjusted the default resolution to 1920x1080.

notes.title: YOUTUBERS LIFE 2 - NEW PATCH COMING SOON
notes.content:
Dear youtubers,

We are committed to improving your gaming experience and will continue to work on updating the game to make sure that you are enjoying Youtubers Life 2.

After reading your comments and feedback, we are happy to announce that we are currently working on a new patch that will give you more details about how to play and become the top youtuber, enhancing specific indications of how to carry out actions and complete missions around the city:

[h3][b]Improving Youtubers Life 2 Onboarding.[/b][/h3]
We are adjusting the initial tutorial and the number of coins you can get at the beginning of your journey, then you will be able to start your way as an emerging youtuber and dive into the first events right away.

[h3][b]Adjusting game quests and commissions.[/b][/h3]
We are implementing new ways to enjoy the first events and get trends when we are exploring them. Therefore, we will make adjustments to FreeticketChallenge, MantendoZiiRumor, and PlayCon missions.

[h3][b]Improving trends discoverability.[/b][/h3]
We will update information on daily trends to know where and how you can find them, creating a smoother experience in your day-to-day hunt. You will be able to learn more about these trends on the map screen, on your InstaLife's feed, and on your mobile menu.

[h3][b]Upgrading the interactions with NPCs.[/b][/h3]
We will boost the way you can interact with other citizens, by indicating their real-time location on your Contacts app to know where you can find them at any time, showing available NPC's missions, and giving you more information about how we can grow our relationship with them.

[h3][b]Balancing the overall gaming experience.[/b][/h3]
To improve your daily life as a youtuber, we are adjusting various general features:
[list]
[*] We will adjust the[b] energy bar display[/b].
[*] We will adjust the video [b]recording minigame[/b].
[*] We will improve the indications when taking the [b]scooter license exam[/b].
[*] Low light conditions for recording will be adjusted, and we will also reduce the coins you need to get the [b]night vision[/b] of your drone, giving you more time and resources to record videos, take photos, and complete missions around the city.
[*] We will improve the [b]USB pen drives[/b] discoverability around the city.
[*] General [b]bug fixes and improvements[/b].[/list]
Thank you so much for your precious feedback that helps us to enhance your gaming experience. We will keep updating the game based on all your suggestions so, remember, if you want to share your experience playing Youtubers Life 2, or just have a nice time with the community, we encourage you to visit our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1493760/discussions/?snr=1_2108_9__2107]Steam discussions[/url] or participate in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/aDEmU2j7KC]Discord server[/url].

We and all citizens from NewTube City are incredibly happy to have you on board!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/e0ec2baea3f2b11f86c2c3f8a79a27a48a2078a5.jpg[/img]

Happy gaming!

We are implementing new ways to enjoy the first events and get trends when we are exploring them. Therefore, we will make adjustments to FreeticketChallenge, MantendoZiiRumor, and PlayCon missions.
